description: This file contains the implementation of the Hogan templating engine, including template rendering, parsing, and compilation functions, with custom delimiters and section handling.

classes.name: Hogan.Template
classes.description: Class representing a Hogan template with methods for rendering, partials, sections, and variable handling.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.r
methods.description: Render function to be replaced by generated code.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.render
methods.description: Render the template with given context and partials.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.ri
methods.description: Internal render hook for overrides, also handles partials.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.rs
methods.description: Render a section, iterating over arrays.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.s
methods.description: Start a section, handling booleans, functions, and arrays.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.fl
methods.description: Flush the buffer to produce output.
